intro.title: Bring your project into chat.
paragraphs: Create an account to add your notes, files and images. Work with AI in each document's thread, then use saved documents in new project conversations.

images.alt: A woman working on her project with a laptop and notebook.
A man reviewing a project sketch beside his laptop.

aside.title: Before you add files
paragraphs: Read [How your materials are processed and stored](/ai-chat/social/profiles/create#how-your-materials-are-processed-and-stored), including external AI processing and backup retention after deletion.
